import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Focus on Season 6 yellowtail data
trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[trips['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Calculate yt per angler by class and day
s6_trips['yt_per_angler'] = s6_trips['yt'] / s6_trips['anglers']

# Key windows from notes
early_window = (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 40) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 121)
recovery_window = (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 160) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 182)
soft_recovery = (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 161) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 170)
peak_recovery = (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 176) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 177)
late_surge = (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 200)

# Multi-day classes
multi_day = s6_trips['cls'].isin(['overnight', 'day_1_5'])

# Aggregate by window and class
print("=== EARLY SEASON (d40-d121) ===")
early = s6_trips[early_window]
for cls in ['overnight', 'day_1_5', 'three_quarter']:
    c = early[early['cls'] == cls]
    if len(c) > 0:
        avg = c['yt_per_angler'].mean()
        count = len(c)
        print(f"{cls}: {avg:.2f} yt/angler ({count} trips)")

print("\n=== RECOVERY WINDOW (d160-d182) ===")
recovery = s6_trips[recovery_window]
print(f"Multi-day (overnight+day_1_5): {recovery[recovery['cls'].isin(['overnight', 'day_1_5'])]['yt_per_angler'].mean():.2f} yt/angler")
